Broccoli Oatmeal Breakfast Casserole
By: iipfit
Published: Thursday, October 16, 2014 - 8:10am

Ingredients




1 ½ cups broccoli florets
2 cups dry quick oats
½ tsp cayenne pepper
2 tsp baking powder
¾ tsp salt
4 large eggs
1 tbsp. olive oil
3 tbsp. low fat milk

Preparation

1 1. Preheat the oven at 350 degree Fahrenheit. Prepare 8 inch square baking dish with cooking spray. 2 2. Grind the broccoli separately in a food processor and combine it with all the dry ingredients in a mixing bowl. 3 3. In another bowl combine all the wet ingredients. 4 4. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and mix well. 5 5. Spoon the batter into the baking dish and put it in the oven. 6 6. Bake it for 25-30 minutes or until the fork comes out clean. 7 7. Cut into desired size and serve hot with ketchup.

About

Broccoli Oatmeal Breakfast Casserole - healthy and filling morning fuel because breakfast is an important meal of the day
